head_commit.message:
feat(security): complete full architectural remediations for OPEN-03, OPEN-11, and OPEN-12

- OPEN-03 (IAM Initial Password Lifecycle):
  * Added migration 006_add_must_change_password_to_users.sql and updated consolidated-migrations.sql
  * Updated gateway /api/v1/auth/login and /login-otp/verify to return PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED with temporary session token
  * Added POST /api/v1/auth/change-password endpoint with Bcrypt hashing and session token decoding
  * Updated UserModal (Modals.tsx) with custom temporary password entry and mandatory change enforcement
  * Added mandatory password reset workflow and UI card in LoginView.tsx
- OPEN-11 (Google Identity Services SSO):
  * Integrated Google Identity Services (accounts.google.com/gsi/client) in index.html
  * Connected Google GIS prompt/callback in LoginView.tsx to post signed credential to /api/v1/auth/sso/google
- OPEN-12 (Centralized SIEM Log Shipping & Alerting):
  * Created fluent-bit.conf with rate limit breach (429), unauthenticated spike (401), and security alert regex filters
  * Registered fluent-bit service container in docker-compose.yml
